newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northeast spot power steady amid nuke outages.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northeast spot power steady amid nuke outages.

text.p: Spot wholesale electricity prices in the northeastern U.S. stayed steady Thursday versus Wednesday levels amid outages of a couple of regional nuclear power plants, marketers said.
The 470 megawatt (MW) Ginna 1 nuclear station in Ontario, N.Y., was taken off line today so its operator Rochester Gas and Electric Corp could perform diagnostic tests on its transformer.

Restart of the 510 MW Vermont Yankee nuclear facility in Vernon, Vt., was delayed to this weekend from today after the Nuclear Regulatory Commission requested for more fire protection data for the plant.
Daily power trading remained thin with spot supply avaiable on a limited basis, utilities and marketers said.
Spot natural gas prices fell for a second day, with New York City gate swing deliveries heard off as much as 20 cents per million British thermal units in the $2.85 area.
In western NYPP, peak, non-firm electricity for Friday delivery was assessed at $20.00-$21.00 a megawatt hour (MWh), a tighter range than Wednesday's $20.00-$23.00.
Western NYPP power for non-firm delivery during Friday's light load hours was discussed at $14.00-$15.00, flat from Wednesday.
In the eastern part of NYPP, peak, non-firm electricity for next-day delivery was pegged at $29.00-$30.00, compared with a notationally assessment near $26.00.
Off-peak, non-firm electricity for next-day delivery in eastern NYPP was again valued in the $14.50-$15.00 range.
In the New England Power Pool (NEPOOL), next-day, peak electricity for Friday at the Northeast Utilities border was discussed at $29.00-$31.00, off from Wednesday's quote of $31.00-$33.00.
Non-firm, off-peak NEPOOL power for next-day delivery to the NU border was quoted at $19.00-$20.00, flat from Wednesday.
At the Northeast-Quebec border, next-day, non-firm electricity for peak hour delivery was offered at $21.00 and for off-peak delivery at $17.00.
November electricity deliveries at the Northeast-Quebec border was offered at $23.00 and December deliveries at $24.00.
